About me:
This is my first time working with DAZ or RenPy so any feedback is appreciated.
I think my weakest points right now are lighting and outdoor environments.

About the game:
There's going to be quite a bit of kinks in this game, I realize not everything is for everyone so pretty much all scenes will be avoidable except for vanilla scenes with the main family. The family relationship is not optional because it would create a ridiculous amount of alternate scenes to make but each non-vanilla scene will mostly be optional.
Swipe Up - Menu
Swipe Down - Hide UI
Swipe Left - Rollback
Swipe Right - Skip


Note: If you're on android, make sure you make the save at the "Save now" screen. Part 2 will overwrite Part 1 when you install it. After that you can just load your save like normal. For PC/Mac, just start the game and load the save. There is also an autosave in case you forgot.
Note: You need to play Part 1/2/3/4/5 and save exactly when the game tells you to before you can play Part 2/3/4/5/6
Note2: Same instructions for switching from Part 2 to Part 3, Part 3 to Part 4 and Part 4 to Part 5 and Part 5 to Part 6
